orientations.intent: Determine whether any of the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish a checklist to a remote release system.

final_message: No — none of these tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish the checklist to a remote release system. That capability is unavailable in the reachable toolset; they only support local operations like inspecting/building the repo, running tests, git operations, and episode history — no remote publishing capability exists among them.
